name: searing burst
desc:
the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} emits magical, divine energy. Each creature of its choice in a 10-foot radius must make a  DC 23 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage plus 14 (4d6) radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
